description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Inbound Delivery provides a way to interact with the [Inbound Delivery (A2X) API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_INBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV_0002/overview). The service allows to create, read, update and delete inbound deliveries with their items, partners, texts and document flow, to manage serial numbers, and to put away items and post or reverse the goods receipt.
key-features: Create, read, update and delete inbound deliveries and their items
Read delivery partners with their addresses, texts and document flow, and add or remove serial numbers
Put away one or all items, split batches, and post or reverse the goods receipt
